entries.definition_en:
δια-νόημα, -τος, τό
 (διανοέομαι, to think), [in LXX for מַחֲשָׁבָה, etc., Isa.55:9, al., frequently in Sir ;] 
a thought: Luk.11:17.†
 (AS)

δικαίωσις, -εως, ἡ
 (δικαιόω), [in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, Lev.24:22 * ;] 
the act of pronouncing righteous, justification, acquittal: Rom.4:25 5:18 (Cremer, 199).†
 (AS)

διστάζω
 (δίς), 
to doubt, hesitate: Mat.14:31 28:17.†
 SYN.: ἀπορέω, διαπορέω, διακρίνομαι, μετεωρίζομαι (see DCG, i, 491) (AS)

εἴκω, 
 [in LXX: 2Ki.12:7 (ענה), Wis.18:25, 4Ma.1:6 * ;] 
to yield: Gal.2:5 (cf. ὑπ-είκω).†
 (AS)

ἐκ-λανθάνω 
 [in Sm.: Psa.13:2 * ;] 
to escape notice utterly; mid., to forget utterly: Heb.12:5.†
 (AS)

Ἐπαίνετος (Rec. -τός), -ου, ὁ 
 Epænetus, a Christian of Borne: Rom.16:5.†
 (AS)

ἐπ-αν-ίστημι 
 [in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;] 
to raise up against; mid., to rise up against: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Mat.10:21, Mrk.13:12.†
 (AS)

ἑτοίμως, 
 adv. [in LXX: Est.7:17 ff, Dan LXX TH Dan.3:15 * ;] 
readily: 1Pe.4:5; ἑ. ἔχω, to be ready (Deiss., BS, 252; MM, Exp., xiv): with inf., Act.21:13, 2Co.12:14.†
 (AS)

ἡμιθανής, -ές
 (ἥμι, half + θνήσκω) [in LXX: 4Ma.4:11 * ;] 
half-dead: Luk.10:30.†
 (AS)

κόκκος, -ου, ὁ 
 [in LXX: La 4:5 B א R (תּוֹלָע), Sir.45:11 * ;] 
a grain: Mat.13:31 17:20, Mrk.4:31, Luk.13:19 17:6, Jhn.12:24, 1Co.15:37.†
 (AS)

κομψός, -ή, -όν
 (κομέω, to take care of), 
well-dressed, elegant, fine; compar. neut., κομψότερον ἔχειν (cf. κόμψως ἔχειν, Epict., and colloq. Eng., "to be doing finely"): Jhn.4:52.†
 (AS)

νήπιος, -α, -ον 
 [in LXX chiefly for עוֹלֵל, also for פְּתִי, etc. ;] 
infant; of children and minors: Mat.21:16 (LXX), 1Co.13:11, Gal.4:1 (see Lft., in l). Metaphorical, childish, unskilled, simple (Psa.19:8, Pro.1:32 al.): Mat.11:25, Luk.10:21, Rom.2:20, Gal.4:3, Eph.4:14, 1Th.2:7 (WH, fox ἤπιοι); opposite to τέλειος, Heb.5:13; ν. ἐν Χριστῷ, 1Co.3:1.†
 (AS)

Πάταρα, -ων, τὰ 
 Patara, a maritime city of Lycia: Act.21:1.†
 (AS)

πατριά, -ᾶς, ἡ
 (πατήρ), [in LXX chiefly for אָב, Exo.6:14, al., also for מִשְׁפָּחָה, Exo.6:15, 4Ki.14:7, Psa.22:27, al. ;] 
__1. lineage, ancestry (Hdt.). 
 __2. = πάτρα (more common in cl.), a family or tribe (so sometimes in Hdt., in LXX of related people, in a sense narrower than φυλή and wider than οἶκος; see Exo.12:3, Num.32:28): Luk.2:4; in a wider sense (1Ch.16:28, Psa.22:27), Act.3:25" (LXX) Eph.3:15.†
 (AS)

ῥιπίζω
 (ῥιπίς, a fan) [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:35 (נְשָׂא) * ;] 
primarily, to fan a fire, hence generally, to make a breeze (Plut., al.). In pass. (cf. Philo, de inter. round., 24), to be tossed or blown by the wind: of waves, ἀνεμιζομένῳ καὶ ῥιπιζομένῳ, blown and raised with the wind (Hort, in l), Jas.1:6.†
 (AS)

στεῖρος, -ον also -α, -ον, 
 [in LXX for עָקָר ;] 
barren: of a woman, Luk.1:7, 36 23:29, Gal.4:27" (LXX) .†
 (AS)

σχολή, -ῆς, ἡ 
 [in LXX: Gen.33:14 (κατὰ σ., אַט), Pro.28:19, Sir.38:24 * ;] 
__1. leisure. 
 __2. Later (from Plato on), 
 __(a) that for which leisure is employed, a disputation, lecture; 
 __(b) the place where lectures are delivered, a school: Act.19:9 (for the later sense of employment, see MM, xxiv).†
 (AS)

φράσσω 
 [in LXX: Job.38:8 (סָכַךְ hi.), Hos.2:6(8) (שׂוּךְ), Pro.21:13 (אָטַם), etc. ;] 
to fence in, stop, close: στόματα λεόντων, Heb.11:33; στόμα, metaphorically, Rom.3:19; pass., καύχησις, 2Co.11:10.†
 (AS)

ἀπ-έναντι 
 adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX); 
 __1. over against (MM, see word): Mat.27:61, Mrk.12:41, WH, mg. 
 __2. before, in the presence of: Mat.27:24 (WH, mg.), Act.3:16, Rom.3:18. 
 __3. against: Act.17:7.†
 (AS)
